description: This file contains CSS styles for the layout and design of a tic-tac-toe game frontend, including theme variables, game board styles, square styles, and responsive design adjustments.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container with centered text alignment and background color.

classes.name: game-status
classes.description: Styles for displaying the game status text, including font size and color.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Styles for the game board layout, using grid display for the tic-tac-toe squares.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Styles for the individual tic-tac-toe squares, including size, background color, and hover effects.

classes.name: restart-button
classes.description: Styles for the restart button, including background, text color, padding, and hover effects.
